{{Quote|You never know where those dancing Balinaka will show up!|[[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Fode]]|<ref name="AS" />}}
A '''trio of Balinaka dancers''' performed on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="AS" /> around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Timeline">During the events of ''[[Star Wars: Anakin's Speedway]]'', the young [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] still lives on Tatooine and wears his slave outfit, but he already knows [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. This implies the events of the game happened shortly before the Boonta Eve podrace.</ref> Those [[Balinaka]] artists from the [[Water/Legends|icy]] world of [[Garnib]]<ref name="POTG1">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume One]]''</ref> danced at the [[podracers' hovel]], performing a chorus-line routine on stage.<ref name="AS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Balinaka were introduced as comical background characters in ''[[Star Wars: Anakin's Speedway]]'', a children's [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[Lucas Learning]] in [[2000]].<ref name="AS" /> It was [[Maryn Roos]], the Lead Artist on the project, who chose to include the bear-like beings into the game after discovering them in old [[West End Games]] material for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Baroness">{{Blogspot|subdomain=baronesss|url=2012/07/day-26-baroness.html|name=Blog O' the Baroness 2.0|text=day 26: the baroness|date=2012-07-27}}</ref>
